data.case_title: Statutory accident insurance recognizes son's school-commute accident as a work accident
data.title: Work accident recognized (Arbeitsunfall) – Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte
data.summary: Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte recognized the fall of the person's son Paul on his bicycle commute to primary school on 14 September 2026 as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall) under § 8 Abs. 2 SGB VII, and will cover the medical treatment and physiotherapy costs directly with the treating practices.
data.explanation: This is good news: the accident insurer has accepted responsibility for your son's school-commute accident and will pay the doctors and physiotherapists directly, so you do not need to submit any receipts yourself. The letter also includes the standard notice that you may file an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree with any part of the decision; the app shows until when based on the one-month period that starts once the letter counts as officially delivered. If you take no action, the decision simply stands as issued.
